items.exampleEn: The young scientist was so unworldly that she didn't know how to pay a bill.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕科學家不諳世事到連帳單都不知道怎麼繳。

items.exampleEn: The soft sofa looked invitingly comfortable after the long day.
items.exampleZh: 忙了一整天之後，那張軟沙發看起來舒服得令人心動。

items.exampleEn: The judges said the singer was untalented, but she proved them wrong.
items.exampleZh: 評審說那位歌手沒天分，但她證明他們錯了。

items.exampleEn: The long speech grew wearisome after the first hour.
items.exampleZh: 那場冗長的演講在一個小時後就變得令人厭倦。

items.exampleEn: Her new job offered a freedom undreamed of in her old office.
items.exampleZh: 她的新工作帶來了在舊辦公室時夢想不到的自由。

items.exampleEn: The gracefulness of the old stone bridge made it famous.
items.exampleZh: 那座古石橋的優美讓它聲名遠播。

items.exampleEn: In the story, a lazy layabout suddenly becomes a hero.
items.exampleZh: 在那個故事裡，一個無所事事的懶漢突然變成了英雄。

items.sentenceEn: The little cafe glowed invitingly on the dark, rainy street.
items.sentenceZh: 那家小咖啡館在漆黑的雨夜街頭透出誘人的燈光。

items.audioEn: The train ride was so wearisome that half of the passengers fell asleep.
items.audioZh: 那趟火車旅程無聊到一半的乘客都睡著了。
options: Took a nap on the way

items.sentenceEn: Today, children have chances undreamed of by their grandparents.
items.sentenceZh: 今天的孩子擁有祖父母那一代夢想不到的機會。

items.sentenceEn: Don't call him a layabout; he works at night and sleeps during the day.
items.sentenceZh: 別說他是懶漢，他是晚上工作、白天睡覺。

items.stemEn: Having grown up with very protective parents, my cousin was so ____ that he believed every stranger's story.
items.stemZh: 我的表親從小被父母保護得很好，不諳世事到相信每個陌生人說的故事。

items.stemEn: The swan moved across the lake with great ____.
items.stemZh: 那隻天鵝以極優雅的姿態滑過湖面。

items.passageEn: Last year, my cousin Owen joined a dance class for beginners. He thought he was completely untalented, and the first lessons were wearisome, because he kept falling behind. His friends joked that he was a layabout who would quit within a week. But the teacher's gracefulness inspired him, and he practiced every evening. Six months later, he danced in a small ballet show and enjoyed a success that had been undreamed of when he started.
items.passageZh: 去年，我的表親 Owen 參加了一個初學者舞蹈班。他覺得自己完全沒天分，頭幾堂課也很累人，因為他一直跟不上。朋友們開玩笑說他是個懶漢，不到一週就會放棄。不過老師的優雅姿態激勵了他，他每天晚上都練習。六個月後，他在一場小型芭蕾演出中登台，獲得了剛開始時夢想不到的成功。

questions.questionZh: 頭幾堂課為什麼很累人？

items.promptZh: 我完全沒有畫畫的天分，但我很喜歡畫。
referenceEn: I'm completely untalented at drawing, but I love it.
I am totally untalented at drawing, but I really enjoy it.
rubricZh: 要用 untalented（例如 untalented at drawing）
「但我很喜歡」可寫，例如 but I love it、but I enjoy it 等

items.promptZh: 這份工作很好，但每天長途通勤很累人。
referenceEn: The job is great, but the long journey to work every day is wearisome.
The job is good, but traveling so far to work each day is wearisome.
rubricZh: wearisome 當形容詞（例如 is wearisome 等）
「每天長途通勤」可寫，例如 the long journey to work every day、the long commute 等
